evidence: RUNTIME FACT LIST (each stated, cross-checked against test.sh consumer): (1) path /app — instruction.md:13 'Put the application in /app'; test.sh:68 refuses without /app/server.js. (2) start command — instruction.md:13 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5 'starts from /app/server.js'; test.sh:104-111 launches node "$APP_ENTRY" (either /app/server.js or the writable copy /tmp/submission/server.js), and hireops_rules.md:198-201 warns 'may launch a writable copy of the submitted application. Resolve bundled UI and seed files relative to the entry or module directory, never by assuming the current working directory is /app.' (3) port — instruction.md:13 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set)'; integration.md:5-6 'port 3000 on 0.0.0.0'; test.sh:108 PORT="3000", probes 127.0.0.1:3000; app_context URL http://localhost:3000. (4) storage/DB_PATH — instruction.md:13 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8 same; test.sh:98/101/109 DB_PATH=/app/app.db or the copy's app.db; restart helper reuses the same DB_PATH (test.sh:165). instruction.md:15 'start with no shipped database, and keep new work across restarts' matches hro_restart. (5) health path — instruction.md:13 'expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:9-10; test.sh:48 probes /api/health then /. (6) env — hireops_rules.md:202 'The launch environment contains PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT and DB_PATH; do not rely on inherited shell variables' exactly matches test.sh:104-109 env -i set; unprivileged run stated (rules:199) matching setpriv --reuid=65534. Dependencies: instruction.md:13 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4 Node 22 + Express + better-sqlite3 via NODE_PATH, matching tests/Dockerfile node:22 + express@5.1.0 + better-sqlite3@12.4.1 and NODE_PATH. Symlink rule (test.sh:72-83) stated in integration.md:16-19. (7) seed — instruction.md:13,15 '/assets/seed_data.json', 'Copy what you need into /app; /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime', 'Load ... once'; rules §9 explains read markers ('how many messages ... counted from its first') which the graded Lena=1 unread figure needs (seed: Lena APP-301 read_count 2 of 3, remaining message from Farah). (8) accounts — instruction.md:17 lists all 10 emails with roles and password Hireops!2026, identical to app_context.md:8-19. (9) fixed clock — N-A sub-item: the task has no fixed clock and no graded rule depends on a calendar date; the only time rules are real-time windows ('within fifteen seconds', instruction.md:5, rules §5) and ordering (newest first / most recent 30), which wall-clock satisfies; seed timestamps are 2026-07, before any realistic run date. Network public: no offline constraint required (instruction.md:13 even permits CDN on the browser side). GRADED -> ASKED walk over all 49 criteria: gates (wrong password stays signed out + staff workspace; job+candidate seen by Observer in independent context) map to instruction.md:17 sign-in and rules §2. Functional rows map: hro_job_open -> rules §2 'whole number from 1 to 50', 'hiring manager is chosen from the hiring-manager accounts'; hro_add_email_rules -> rules:32-35 (case-insensitive duplicate, 'say so at that field and keep what was typed', other job allowed); hro_move_one_stage/arrive_bottom/reorder/reject_reason/reject_hired/reopen -> rules §3 bullets and 'Order inside a stage'; reopen-undo restoring reason -> rules:96-97; hro_interview_full/reorder_free/undo_full -> rules 'Interview places' + undo overfill (rules:98-99); hro_refused_put_back focus -> rules:84-85 'keyboard focus stays on that card's controls'; manager/observer/candidate permission rows -> rules §1/'Who may move what'; hro_anonymous 401 -> rules:21; hro_stale_refused 'by whom' -> instruction.md:3 + rules:77-80; bulk rows (board order, all-or-none, places counted for set) -> rules:89-92; undo rows (note not a change, re-order blocks, once only, earlier move no longer undoable) -> rules:96-100; activity rows -> rules §4 (rejection line includes reason, newest first, all jobs or one job, refused adds none); notes -> rules:104-106; live board/message/unread/seen within 15 s -> instruction.md:5,7 + rules §5/§6; thread paging 30 + count + place -> rules:144-147; compose Enter/Shift+Enter/blank/focus -> rules:138-140; drafts per conversation/reload -> rules:170-175; candidate view wording/privacy/linked/404 -> rules §7, rules:21-23, rules:35-36; hro_restart seeded order Greta/Ade/Marco, Priya/Samuel and Noor's note -> seed (verified positions) + instruction.md:15. Polish rows -> rules §5 (typing, focus, open card, scroll preserved), rules:146-147 (earlier messages keep place), rules:140 (failed send stays, told not sent), rules:105-106 (unsaved note kept for that person on that browser), rules:170-174 (ended session -> asked to sign in, reply restored, no other person sees it). Visual likert rows are professional-default craft judged on desktop, consistent with instruction.md:11 'A clear desktop workspace is what matters. We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout' (visual rows grade neither). No graded route, selector, label or field name: app_context.md:33-34 and functional prompt line 15 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'. ADVERSARIAL: (a) Plausible broken app that could pass this row's concern — an app that hard-codes cwd=/app for seed/UI loading would break under the writable-copy launch, but that launch mode is disclosed in rules §8, so the failure is attributable to the submission, not to a hidden contract. An app that ignores DB_PATH and writes /app/app.db still persists in the common case (test.sh points DB_PATH at /app/app.db when writable), so no unfair failure arises either way. (b) Conforming alternative that could fail — an app that keeps the session per tab, hides refused controls, uses SSE/WebSocket, or stores drafts server-side: each is explicitly tolerated (polish session_resume per-tab fallback; prompt replay rule for hidden controls; rules:123 'Polling, server-sent events and sockets are all acceptable'; rules:175 'Where drafts are kept is yours'). An app binding only to 127.0.0.1 would still pass the probe (test.sh probes 127.0.0.1). No unstated runtime assumption found. Minor observations (not defects): the ~30 s readiness window (test.sh:116-125, 120 x 0.25 s) is not stated, but the brief requires health to answer before DB work (integration.md:9-10), so a conforming app is not at risk. This row's verdict is source-level; it is not a portal checker run of check-runtime-contract-strings.py and makes no claim about Oracle, model scores or judge duration.
